title: How to start a movement | Derek Sivers
speaker: Derek Sivers

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, at TED we talk a lot about leadership and how to make a movement.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们,在TED上,我们谈论了很多关于领导和如何开展运动的问题。

sentences.en: So let's watch a movement happen, start to finish, in under three minutes and dissect some lessons from it.
sentences.zh: 让我们看着一个运动发生, 开始完成, 不到三分钟 并解开一些教训。

sentences.en: First, of course you know, a leader needs the guts to stand out and be ridiculed.
sentences.zh: 首先,你当然知道,一个领袖需要勇气 站出来,被嘲笑。

sentences.en: What he's doing is so easy to follow. Here's his first follower with a crucial role; he's going to show everyone else how to follow.
sentences.zh: 这是他第一个有关键作用的追随者,他要向其他人展示如何跟随。

sentences.en: Now, notice that the leader embraces him as an equal.
sentences.zh: 现在,请注意, 领导人拥抱他 作为平等的。

sentences.en: Now it's not about the leader anymore; it's about them, plural.
sentences.zh: 现在它不再是关于领导者, 而是关于他们, 复数。

sentences.en: Now, there he is calling to his friends.
sentences.zh: 现在,他正在打电话给他的朋友。

sentences.en: Now, if you notice that the first follower is actually an underestimated form of leadership in itself.
sentences.zh: 现在,如果你注意到第一个追随者 其实是一个被低估的 领导形式本身。

sentences.en: It takes guts to stand out like that. The first follower is what transforms a lone nut into a leader.
sentences.zh: 第一个追随者就是把一个孤独的坚果变成一个领导者

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) And here comes a second follower.
sentences.zh: (笑) (掌声) 和这里来了第二个追随者。

sentences.en: Now it's not a lone nut, it's not two nuts -- three is a crowd, and a crowd is news.
sentences.zh: 现在它不是一个孤独的坚果,它不是两个坚果—— 三个是人群,而一个人群是新闻。

sentences.en: So a movement must be public. It's important to show not just the leader, but the followers, because you find that new followers emulate the followers, not the leader.
sentences.zh: 所以运动必须是公开的。重要的是不仅要展示领袖,还要展示追随者, 因为你发现新的追随者模仿追随者,而不是领导者。

sentences.en: Now, here come two more people, and immediately after, three more people.
sentences.zh: 现在,这里又来了两个人, 和紧接着,三个人。

sentences.en: Now we've got momentum. This is the tipping point.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有动力了,这是临界点

sentences.en: Now we've got a movement. (Laughter) So, notice that, as more people join in, it's less risky.
sentences.zh: 现在,我们有一个运动。 所以,注意, 随着更多的人加入, 它的风险较小。

sentences.en: So those that were sitting on the fence before now have no reason not to.
sentences.zh: 所以以前坐在栅栏上的人 没有理由不这么做

sentences.en: They won't stand out, they won't be ridiculed, but they will be part of the in-crowd if they hurry.
sentences.zh: 他们不会露面,也不会被嘲笑, 但是如果他们动作快,他们就会成为人群的一部分。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So, over the next minute, you'll see all of those that prefer to stick with the crowd because eventually they would be ridiculed for not joining in.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 所以,在接下来的一分钟, 你会看到所有的人 喜欢坚持在人群中, 因为他们最终会 被嘲笑 因为他们不加入。

sentences.en: And that's how you make a movement. But let's recap some lessons from this.
sentences.zh: 这就是你运动的方式。但让我们从中总结一些教训。

sentences.en: So first, if you are the type, like the shirtless dancing guy that is standing alone, remember the importance of nurturing your first few followers as equals so it's clearly about the movement, not you.
sentences.zh: 所以首先,如果你是那种人, 就像那个独自站着的裸体舞者, 记住培养你前几个追随者的重要性, 所以这显然是关于运动, 而不是关于你。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Okay, but we might have missed the real lesson here.
sentences.zh: 好吧,但我们可能 错过了真正的教训在这里。

sentences.en: The biggest lesson, if you noticed -- did you catch it? -- is that leadership is over-glorified.
sentences.zh: 最大的教训,如果你注意到了-- 你抓住了吗?-- 就是领导权被夸大了。

sentences.en: Yes, it was the shirtless guy who was first, and he'll get all the credit, but it was really the first follower that transformed the lone nut into a leader.
sentences.zh: 是的,是那个不穿衬衫的家伙先来的, 他会得到所有的功劳, 但它真的第一个追随者 把孤独的坚果变成一个领导者。

sentences.en: So, as we're told that we should all be leaders, that would be really ineffective.
sentences.zh: 所以,正如我们被告知的,我们都应该成为领导者, 那将是真正的无效的。

sentences.en: If you really care about starting a movement, have the courage to follow and show others how to follow.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的关心 启动运动, 有勇气跟随 并告诉别人如何跟随。

sentences.en: And when you find a lone nut doing something great, have the guts to be the first one to stand up and join in.
sentences.zh: 当你发现一个孤单的疯子做一些伟大的事情时, 就有勇气成为第一个站出来加入的人。

sentences.en: And what a perfect place to do that, at TED.
sentences.zh: 在TED,这是个多么完美的地方。

sentences.en: Thanks. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢 (掌声)
